summary: Tested context badges API for Vision Intel Suite. All 15 backend tests pass. Badge resolution logic correctly activates badges for LaMelo Ball (locked_in + milestone), Donovan Mitchell (milestone + home_cookin), James Harden (milestone), and other players based on stats-based criteria.

minor.issue: Returns 200 with success=false instead of 404 for missing players - not a bug, by design

player_with_badges_endpoint.description: GET /api/v3/player-with-badges/{player_name} returns player data with active_badges and badges arrays

active_badges_array.description: Response contains active_badges array at player level with badge keys

badges_array_with_objects.description: Response contains badges array with full badge objects (badge_key, display, icon, color, description, severity)

locked_in_badge.description: Activates when L5 PPG > Season PPG + 5 (verified for LaMelo Ball: L5=24.4, Season=19.3, diff=5.1)

milestone_badge.description: Activates when stat avg is within 5% of round milestone (20, 25, 30...). LaMelo Ball: 31.2 PRA near 30, Donovan Mitchell: 38.5 PRA near 40

home_cookin_badge.description: Activates when home PPG is 15%+ higher than away. Donovan Mitchell: Home 29.2 is 22% higher than away 24.0

gassed_badge.description: No players in today's cache have back-to-back games (1 day between games)

jet_lag_badge.description: Players with context_engine flags (Luka, LeBron, KD) not in today's cached board

legal_noise_badge.description: Players with context_engine flags not in today's cached board

revenge_badge.description: Players with context_engine flags not in today's cached board

badge_data_format.description: All badge keys match BADGE_REGISTRY, severity is 1-10, colors are valid hex codes

Russell Westbrook.status: PASSED - No badges (averages not near milestones)

critical_code_review_comments: resolve_context_badges() correctly implements 8 of 10 badges (pay_day and deep_water are placeholders requiring contract/playoff data)
Badge data format matches frontend BADGE_REGISTRY in BadgePill.jsx
Badges are attached at player level (active_badges, badges) and also to each prop (active_badges, intel_suite.context_badges)
Context engine flags (jet_lag, legal_noise, revenge, distraction) require players with active flags in nba_context_engine collection
seed_data_creation: N/A - uses existing nba_master_hub_2026 and dg_cached_board data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Context badges are working for stats-based badges (locked_in, milestone, home_cookin, gassed). Flag-based badges (jet_lag, legal_noise, revenge, distraction) require players with active flags in nba_context_engine collection - test data exists for Luka/LeBron/KD but they're not in today's cached board. pay_day and deep_water badges are placeholders.
